sentences.span: This strength has almost fully offset the multiple compression we've seen since May, a sign that the discounting process for the aforementioned risks is well advanced
sentences.why: No source states equities 'have not finished discounting' the yield repricing; the one bank source that speaks to this directly (Morgan Stanley) argues the opposite — that the discounting process is 'well advanced.' The stance in s1 is not attributable to any bank in the source set.

sentences.span: input cost inflation being the largest monthly increase since 2020 (now around its highest level since late 2022)
sentences.why: JPM's afternoon briefing directly supports the figure and attribution; the causal reasoning about disinflation/central-bank credibility is analytical framing on top of that sourced fact, not a new unsourced figure or misattribution.

sentences.span: we'll hear from the Fed's Williams, Barkin, Hammack and Paulson, the ECB's Schnabel and Lane, and the BoE's Dhingra, Breeden and Lombardelli
sentences.why: Every source mentioning Williams and Paulson only lists them as scheduled to speak later Thursday (10:05am/10:10am ET); no document reports what either of them actually said, so 'saying it out loud... is confirmation' has no support.

sentences.span: yields are moving towards fair value (5.5%), similar episodes have historically been buying opportunities, equity valuations offer a cushion
sentences.why: JPM's fair-value estimate of 5.5% for the 10-year and the buying-opportunity framing for past overshoot episodes are both directly stated.

sentences.span: $70bn of notes were sold at 5.03%, +3.1bps above the pre-sale yield ... taking it up to a post-2007 high of 5.11%
sentences.why: 5.11% is the 10-year Treasury yield, not the five-year auction yield. The five-year auction (confirmed by both this source and the JPM briefing's '3.20bp tail') cleared at 5.03%, not 5.11%. The sentence misattributes the 10-year's yield level to the five-year auction it claims tested it.

PCE release on September 30 is confirmed as the near-term catalyst; JPM's 5.5% level as the decision threshold is corroborated by s4's source. The specific 8:30 AM ET timestamp isn't independently stated in-text but is standard for this release and doesn't change the substance.
No source frames the put-option purchase as 'more informative' than the underlying position; this is unattributed opinion with no bank stance behind it.

No document in the source set describes a 'core position' of overweight mega-cap/memory/semis funded by a short $IWM position on a three-to-twelve-month view; 'benchmark,' 'three to twelve month,' and 'short IWM' do not appear anywhere in the corpus.

sentences.span: We initiated the lower-vol Earnings Vulnerability JPUXERNV Index basket as a hedge versus Semis/AI SMH Equity. It has delivered similar directional exposure, with ~70% beta to Semis, while offering options that are ~5–7 vols cheaper
sentences.why: The put option JPM is actually buying is on the JPUXERNV 'Earnings Vulnerability' basket, described in-source as a lower-vol proxy with ~70% beta to Semis chosen for cheaper options — not as a basket of companies whose earnings are exposed to AI agents taking their business. That AI-agent-disintermediation description belongs to a different, separately named basket in the same document (JPUXCAIV, the 'Muse disintermediation names' basket referenced by a different desk). The 'less premium into month-end rebalancing' clause is faithful; the basket's composition/rationale is conflated with the wrong basket.

sentences.span: SHOP (-7%) is getting whacked today ... EXPE Equity and CART US Equity getting hit despite partnerships announcements
sentences.why: Bridging sentence into s11's sourced single-name moves; the underlying claim (the hedged risk is already showing up in individual stocks) is corroborated by the sourced content it introduces.

sentences.span: SHOP (-7%) is getting whacked today partially on this tweet going around that states: "Meta is working on Meta Pay for Muse" ... EXPE Equity and CART US Equity getting hit despite partnerships announcements ... Insurify said it blocked Meta's Muse agent, and insurers outperformed the rest of Financials today
sentences.why: All figures, tickers, causal framing, and the insurer-outperformance claim are directly supported by JPM's afternoon briefing, correctly attributed.

sentences.span: META (-2% pre-mkt) is lower after its keynote from Connect last night with some investors disappointed by showcase focusing more on hardware (new Muse gadget +vr goggles + audio-only smart glasses)
sentences.why: Meta's expanded hardware lineup (gadget, VR goggles, smart glasses) around the Sept 23-24 Connect event is directly supported, corroborated by GS Duttenhoefer's separate VR-glasses item the same day.

No FOMC meeting occurs today; sources place the next Fed decision in October (with one bank explicitly flagging 'all eyes on today's Trump/Xi summit' as the day's actual meeting). No source ties any Fed outcome to risk on a short small-cap leg, which itself is unsupported per s8.
Vague, unattributed claim with no traceable bank source; it also inherits the unsupported 'meeting'/trade framing from s13.

sentences.span: US Treasury Secretary Bessent saying they'd agreed to extend last year's trade truce by two months, which will now keep tariffs lower until January 10
sentences.why: The truce extension, January 10 date, and today's Trump-Xi summit are all directly supported. No source anywhere in the corpus mentions FXI or any 'summit trade' flagged Tuesday — that specific claim has no basis despite the rest of the sentence being accurate.
